target.source_locator: High-value update: same-construct residual value on public item-level judge traces

classification.published_claim: JudgmentBench publishes 30 real-world legal tasks, 1,539 rubric annotations and 1,530 human pairwise comparative judgments, with mirrored GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4-mini autograder judgments, and reports that comparative judgment recovers the constructed quality ordering better than rubric scoring. This is the paper/dataset claim, not the residual-help/harm claim below.
classification.clean_worker_secondary_claim: On a deterministic 30-row spread sample, treating GPT-5.4-mini as A and GPT-5.4 as B, the larger judge does not show greater descriptive residual help than residual harm against either one observed human preference or the constructed quality ordering. The worker correctly limits this to negative evidence against naive model-name/size escalation in this sample.
classification.official_artifact_support: Strong. The official Hugging Face release exposes human comparative judgments and mirrored GPT-5.4/GPT-5.4-mini comparative judgments for the same completed assignments, plus explicit constructed quality-level ordering. The persisted 30-row sample matches the current public raw release on selected identities, preferences and quality-order fields.
classification.independent_auditor_reproduction: Strong for the fixed sample. Recomputed every reported count, accuracy, p_help, p_harm, disagreement count, quality-gap summary and stated Jeffreys interval directly from the persisted CSV without using worker arithmetic. Current official raw files were cross-checked for the selected rows.
classification.failed_replication: None. No fixed-sample arithmetic mismatch was found.
classification.independent_external_replication: No protocol-matched external reproduction of this residual-help/harm analysis was identified. The 2026-08-26 paper 'Candidate supply and answer selection shape the value of LLM judging in multi-agent systems' independently supports only the broader mechanism that judge reliability varies with task/generator/candidate context; it uses different benchmarks, targets and selection protocol and is not a JudgmentBench replication.
classification.missing_dependencies_or_config: The worker did not pin the Hugging Face revision/file digests, did not preregister or randomize the 30-row selection, did not run a full-corpus split, and did not use cluster-aware uncertainty. The public tree currently shows one commit (visible short revision 945ff52), so current-main verification is possible, but raw/main remains a mutable reference in principle.
classification.o_specific_adaptation: The proposed controller rule to estimate construct-specific p_help/p_harm and preserve no-extra-call abstention is a downstream architecture adaptation. The sample motivates that design boundary but does not validate an operational escalation threshold, cost policy or destructive-promotion gate.

new_audit_boundary.cluster_structure: The 30 selected rows are not 30 independent comparison units. They are 10 complete three-comparison assignment/task-slot clusters; within each cluster the same annotator compares the same constructed three-output set pairwise.
new_audit_boundary.jeffreys_interval_scope: The quoted Jeffreys intervals are mathematically reproduced under an IID Bernoulli likelihood, but they are not defensible population sampling intervals for this deterministic clustered convenience sample. They should be labeled descriptive/IID-model intervals only.
new_audit_boundary.interpretation: Deleting one selected three-row cluster can change the sign of the descriptive residual-help-minus-harm contrast for either target. Therefore the fixed sample supports the narrow statement that naive larger-judge escalation did not dominate on these 30 selected rows; it does not establish that GPT-5.4 has negative residual value in the JudgmentBench population or even that the sign is stable under small cluster perturbations.

public_primary_sources.role: official dataset card, counts, constructed quality ordering and mirrored autograder structure
current public tree; one visible commit, short revision 945ff52

official GPT-5.4-mini mirrored pairwise raw data

independent_context.scope: 15,336 questions and 81,390 fixed candidate-pool replays across other benchmarks; supports context-dependent judge reliability but not JudgmentBench residual help/harm.

safe_conclusion: A construct-qualified residual-value gate is better motivated than escalation by nominal model strength alone, and the exact 30-row worker analysis is fully reproducible from persisted/official data. However the sample is a deterministic 10-cluster convenience slice, so its Jeffreys intervals and negative p_help-p_harm point estimates cannot be generalized to JudgmentBench or to GPT-5.4 versus GPT-5.4-mini broadly. No matched independent external replication was found.
reopen_conditions: full-corpus byte-stable JudgmentBench replay pinned to an immutable dataset revision/file hashes
preregistered held-out or probability-sampled evaluation with task/assignment/annotator-aware uncertainty
matched-call and matched-cost comparison of no-extra-call, escalation, repeat-judge and abstention policies
protocol-matched independent reproduction or failure report
public dataset revision that changes any selected row or paper/dataset semantics
blocker: Population-level residual-value inference remains blocked by nonrandom clustered selection and absence of a matched full-corpus/held-out policy evaluation; this does not block fixed-sample reproduction.
exact_next_action: Do not repeat this JudgmentBench 30-row scope absent a reopen trigger. Audit the remaining exact C29 neuroscience source, preserving its explicit non-reproduction status and separating source-derived CAUSE facts from approximate synthetic family-filter results; prioritize any recoverable author code/raw outputs or matched independent rerun.
